description_en: Creates a NAS file system and binds it to the office network of a shared cloud computer
description_zh: 创建NAS文件系统并且绑定到共享型云电脑的办公网络
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-and-bind-nas-file-system --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-system-name szy-asp-upm-test --storage-type Capacity --office-site-id cn-beijing+dir-1565700000 --desktop-group-id dg-fh0vdzyh6rdc00000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAndBindNasFileSystem

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the NAS file system
parameters.name: file_system_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the NAS file system
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The storage specification type of the NAS file system
parameters.help_zh: NAS文件系统的存储规格类型
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the file system uses a KMS-managed key to encrypt data at rest. Encrypted data does not need to be decrypted during read and write operations.

NAS-managed keys are supported when `FileSystemType` is set to `standard` or `extreme`. User-managed keys are supported when `FileSystemType` is set to `extreme`
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统是否使用KMS服务托管密钥，对文件系统落盘数据进行加密存储。在读写加密数据时，无需解密。

当`FileSystemType`为`standard`或`extreme`时，支持NAS托管密钥；当`FileSystemType`为`extreme`时，支持用户管理密钥
parameters.name: encrypt_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_group_id
